quality_requirements.statement: Frame must read as multiple interacting perceptual planes, not subject plus backdrop.
quality_requirements.verification_method: Confirm visible overlap, scale separation and atmospheric progression across at least three planes.
quality_requirements.failure_condition: Subject appears pasted onto an independent background.

quality_requirements.statement: Primary subject must remain recognizably identical to the supplied asset.
quality_requirements.verification_method: Compare facial structure and distinguishing traits against the identity asset.
quality_requirements.failure_condition: Identity changes, drifts or becomes generic.

quality_requirements.statement: Stylist reads first; reserved left copy area remains visually viable; environment supplies third-level evidence.
quality_requirements.verification_method: Inspect at full size and reduced-size view; focal order must remain unchanged.
quality_requirements.failure_condition: Purple environment or decorative objects compete with face or invade copy region.

quality_requirements.statement: Editorial layers, light and materials must interact with stylist across foreground, subject and background planes.
quality_requirements.verification_method: Inspect edge light, overlap, perspective and atmosphere around subject/environment boundaries.
quality_requirements.failure_condition: Subject reads as separately composited or environmental perspective disagrees.

quality_requirements.statement: Fashion environment must demonstrate editorial authorship through material rhythm, density and framing.
quality_requirements.verification_method: Every prominent environment element must map to a declared narrative, depth or attention function.
quality_requirements.failure_condition: Prominent detail is decorative, generic or unrelated to the narrative.

quality_requirements.statement: Reserved copy region must stay quiet enough for external typography.
quality_requirements.verification_method: Overlay representative HTML copy and verify contrast and unobstructed bounds.
quality_requirements.failure_condition: Hotspots, detail or objects compete with external copy.
